about.title: About V.SCAN
about.body: V.SCAN is my open-source network assessment tool (CLI, no web GUI): discover devices on your LAN and other reachable VLANs (via L3), fingerprint with nmap, run plugin checks (TLS/HTTP/SMB/DNS/exposure/NSE), match CVEs with CVSS, optional SSH credentialed package audit, risk score, and tell you how to fix issues. Powerful when you need depth, light by default (balanced profile). Built by Vazha Lomtatidze.
